blocks.html: In its commitment to provide Filipinos a hassle-free, safe and convenient venue to process various government requirements, Robinsons Malls now serves as the official mall partner of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) to house the registration of the Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) or the national ID.

The PhilSys step 2 registration is currently available at the following malls from Mondays to Saturdays: Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Roxas, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Luisita, and Robinsons Starmills while Robinsons Place Dumaguete and Robinsons Place Antique’s registration are available until Sundays.
Step 2 registration involves the validation of supporting documents and capturing of biometrics such as fingerprint and iris scans and front-facing photographs at registration centers.
Watch out as the registration will soon roll out to your favorite Robinsons Malls nationwide like Robinsons North Tacloban and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu.

The PhilSys or national ID system aims to provide Filipinos a valid proof of identity which can be digitally verified and used in both government and private transactions. It will transform how services are delivered and accessed in the Philippines and accelerate the country’s transition to digital economy.

For more updates, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like Robinsons Malls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
